subject: general
question:
​​​Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef83adf1a9028e9275d62a7a22e9e2f2d4a14b4ae58f5fc4c762d39d3665e983.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.

Let’s check each option:

1. MR - LQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82450511a2c3f428e440b4206848ef5ac09b0bb1c787c1eab42a031e1dbe5d2e.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.

2. EJ - DI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9175e10305c63ac42afd6405c907e73f5fcacdf7934e56c7f523ee3aed39dc6.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.

3. PU - OT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cf005ec431fa9620ce3d56dc3cffa0e96954f263f4123a0618c4ea81ce750e5.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.

4. QV - PV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddbcad364d277acfc9e40c41d4c385e1312a6d5c0c437523e90e89041a48a8d2.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -1, -1.

Thus, QV - PV is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
